title: PCR Cleanup Protocol
author: Alex Zegarra
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgaqjsdw
materials: Discard the filtrate and reuse the collection tube
Let sit at room temperature for 1 min

steps.title: Prepare DNA Mini Column
steps.instruction: Prepare the column by treating it with NaOH and neutralizing it.

substeps.instruction: Insert DNA Mini Column into a 2 mL Collection Tube.
Add 100 uL 3M NaOH to the DNA Mini Column.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 30-60 seconds.
Rinse with 200 uL of Neutralization Buffer (P3) or 3M sodium acetate pH=4.5.

steps.title: Prepare and Load PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Save a sample of the PCR reaction and dilute the remainder before loading onto the column.

substeps.instruction: Save 2 microliters of the PCR reaction mix in a separate tube for a pre-cleanup gel sample.
Dilute the remaining PCR reaction mixture 20-fold (22 uL of PCR reaction to 440 uL) in Mini-Prep PB buffer.
Transfer the entire diluted PCR reaction into the DNA Mini Column.

steps.title: Bind DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample and perform the first wash with PB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute.
Save the filtrate in a separate tube and reuse the collection tube.
Add 500 uL PB Buffer.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 min.
Save the filtrate in the tube from the previous step and reuse the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash DNA Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with PE buffer to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 uL PE (ensure 100% ethanol was added to the PE during preparation).
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 min.
Discard the filtrate and reuse the collection tube.
Optional: Repeat the PE wash step (adding 700 uL PE and centrifuging for 1 min) a second time.

steps.title: Dry Column Matrix
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol from the column to prevent elution interference.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty DNA Mini Column for 2 minutes at maximum speed.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the DNA Mini Column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 40 uL Elution Buffer or sterile deionized water (pH approx 8.5) directly to the center of the column membrane.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Store or Use DNA
steps.instruction: Store the eluted DNA or proceed to gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Store DNA at -20 C or use immediately in a gel.
If PCR amplification is confirmed via the 2 uL saved sample but not seen in elution, attempt to recover DNA from the saved wash by adding more HBC buffer.
